context.task_description: Bring-your-own-credentials for the deployed demo: replace the raw "GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID is required" JSON error with graceful handling, and add an in-app way for a demo visitor to enter their own Google OAuth client ID + secret and their own Anthropic API key, stored encrypted per browser session (no DB), preserving demo-mode parity.
context.trigger: User deployed the dev branch to Vercel (ai-mail-client-tawny.vercel.app). Clicking Connect Gmail hits /api/connect/gmail and returns a raw JSON error {"error":{"code":"request_error","message":"GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID is required"}} because GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID is not set as a Vercel env var. ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is also unset on the deploy. Intent: this is a public demo where each visitor should plug in their own credentials and try the app.
requirements: Replace the raw JSON error path on /api/connect/[provider] (and any sibling route that 500s/400s on missing GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID / GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET) with a graceful redirect to an in-app credentials screen.
Provide an in-app UI surface for a visitor to enter their own Google OAuth client ID + client secret.
Provide an in-app UI surface for a visitor to enter their own Anthropic API key.

Persist entered credentials encrypted, per browser session, with no database (Vercel serverless is stateless) - candidate: httpOnly cookie encrypted via src/server/security/crypto.ts using TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY.

Server code that reads GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID / GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET / ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (src/server/auth/oauth.ts, src/server/ai/anthropic.ts) must prefer the per-session entered value, then fall back to the env var.

Show the visitor what to register in Google Cloud Console for this deploy: the exact redirect URI is <deploy-origin>/api/connect/gmail/callback (e.g. https://ai-mail-client-tawny.vercel.app/api/connect/gmail/callback).
Preserve demo-mode parity: with DEMO_MODE=true and no credentials at all, the app stays fully usable on demo data; the AI deterministic fallback path still runs when no Anthropic key is present.
constraints: no spec drift - if specs/product.md, specs/ai-features.md, or specs/email-adapters.md must change to cover a credentials/settings surface, the product-planner stages that spec edit in this same cooperation before implement, and the reviewer approves it

security-token-review applies: entered OAuth client secret and Anthropic API key must be encrypted at rest, never logged, HTTPS-only, httpOnly cookie; the planner must address how a user-supplied client secret reaches the OAuth callback safely
TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY must be present on the Vercel deploy for encryption to work - the plan must call out this deployment prerequisite
AI endpoints must not send mail (unchanged invariant)
open_design_questions_for_plan: Storage model: encrypted httpOnly cookie vs. other - recommend and justify; note Vercel serverless statelessness.

Single implementer for the implement phase, or does the cross-domain scope (frontend-ux UI + email-integration connect/auth + ai-features Anthropic key) require splitting into more than one cooperation? Decide and record in the plan.
Whether the entered Google credential should also encrypt/scope the existing per-account ProviderCredentials flow, or stay a separate session-level 'app credentials' concept.
